notes: 1.10.9 - safety fix for the new NeoForge updater. On the Minecraft Launcher it could retarget OTHER modpack profiles at our loader version, including packs for a different Minecraft version. It now only touches the profile it is actually updating. If you use Prism, MultiMC, CurseForge or the Modrinth App you were never affected. Everything else from 1.10.x is unchanged.
